name: Bridge USDB
oneLiner: USDB is Bridge's (Stripe) dollar stablecoin powering Stripe Stablecoin Financial Accounts, backed 1:1 by cash and BlackRock MMFs under an OCC trust charter.
collateral: 1:1 USD reserves held in cash and BlackRock money market funds; managed by Bridge (Stripe subsidiary) under conditional OCC national trust bank charter
pegMechanism: Bridge-issued reserve stablecoin: USDB is always backed 1:1 by cash and short-duration BlackRock money market funds, with Bridge APIs supporting fiat and stablecoin conversions including free USDB/USDC conversion

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDB is Bridge's dollar stablecoin for stablecoin financial accounts, with 1:1 reserves and mint/redeem infrastructure managed by Bridge.

launchPhaseDetail: USDB powers Stripe's Stablecoin Financial Accounts in 101 countries; 1:1 backed by USD held in cash and BlackRock money market funds; Bridge received conditional OCC national trust bank charter Feb 2026. At Stripe Sessions 2026 (Apr 29) Bridge expanded stablecoin-backed cards to 30 countries (targeting 100+ by year-end via Visa) and added Tempo/Plasma/Celo/Sui support, COP/GBP on-off-ramps, and SWIFT/FedNow/ACH integration. Bridge Open Issuance now also powers MoneyGram's MGUSD (Stellar, Jun 2) and Deel's DLUSD (Tempo, Jun 3) alongside USDH, CASH, and USDSui; distinct from Blast's USDB (usdb-blast)

featuredContent.title: Stripe rolls out stablecoin accounts in 101 countries as Bridge launches USDB
featuredContent.description: Bridge's USDB underpins Stripe's global stablecoin financial accounts with 1:1 USD backing via cash and BlackRock MMFs.

milestones.title: Bridge receives conditional OCC national trust bank charter
milestones.description: Approval enables Bridge to custody crypto assets, issue stablecoins, and manage reserves as a federally regulated entity.

milestones.title: Payoneer launches stablecoin capabilities powered by Bridge / USDB
milestones.description: Payoneer announces plans to launch stablecoin services embedded in its platform, powered by Bridge; rollout in select markets in Q2 2026 with broader availability throughout the year.

milestones.title: USDB launches powering Stripe's Stablecoin Financial Accounts in 101 countries
Visa and Bridge expand stablecoin-linked cards from 18 to 100+ countries
milestones.description: Visa + Bridge program lets fintechs and wallets issue cards that spend stablecoin balances at Visa's 175M merchant locations; expansion targeted across Europe, Asia Pacific, Africa, and the Middle East by end of 2026.

milestones.title: Stripe Sessions 2026: USDB cards live in 30 countries; new chains and rails added
milestones.description: Bridge announced stablecoin-backed cards live in 30 countries (targeting 100+ by year-end via Visa), Tempo/Plasma/Celo/Sui support, COP and GBP on/off-ramps, and SWIFT/FedNow/ACH pull integration.

milestones.title: MoneyGram launches MGUSD on Stellar via Bridge Open Issuance
milestones.description: MoneyGram issued MGUSD on Stellar using Bridge Open Issuance with M0 contracts and Fireblocks custody, serving 60M users across 200 countries.

milestones.title: Deel launches DLUSD on Tempo via Bridge Open Issuance and Privy
milestones.description: Deel became the first enterprise to combine Bridge, Privy wallets, and Tempo, launching DLUSD to pay workers starting in Argentina.
